description: Synthetic, de-identified transcripts for the call extraction prompt v35 field service_request.estimate_response: the caller's answer to an estimate Waves already sent. Every name and address is invented (Pat Example, Sam, 100 Example Lane, Sampleton); no real call or customer is stored. The cases are the model's judgement to make, so tests pin the contract the model is given and the shape of each expected extraction. Use them as replay inputs for a model bake-off. No consumer reads the field yet.

cases.why: Waves sent an estimate by text earlier; the caller says plainly they go ahead and nothing of theirs is open: accepted, pinned to the caller's sentence (prompt v35).
cases.transcript:
Agent: Waves Pest Control, this is Sam.
Caller: Hi, Pat Example here at 100 Example Lane in Sampleton. I looked at the estimate you sent yesterday.
Agent: Great. That was the quarterly pest plan, ninety-five dollars each visit.
Caller: Yes, let's do it. Go ahead and sign me up.
Agent: Wonderful, I will get that started.

estimate_response_evidence.speaker: caller
estimate_response_evidence.quote: Yes, let's do it. Go ahead and sign me up.
